preconditions.description: The dimensions of the chessboard must be between 3 and 1000.
The coordinates of Alice's queen must be within the bounds of the chessboard.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= b_x <= n and 1 <= b_y <= n and (b_x != a_x or b_y != a_y)
preconditions.description: The coordinates of Bob's king must be within the bounds of the chessboard and not the same as Alice's queen.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= c_x <= n and 1 <= c_y <= n and (c_x != a_x or c_y != a_y) and (c_x != b_x or c_y != b_y)
preconditions.description: The target coordinates must be within the bounds of the chessboard and not the same as Alice's queen or Bob's king.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' indicating whether Bob can reach the target without getting in check.
